texts:
Tank Bigsby needs core muscle surgery and heads to IR for about six weeks. Drop him.

Saquon Barkley still waits on Wednesday's update before London.

Will Shipley is the only other Eagles back. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.

Let's look into it.
#FlyEaglesFly

Saquon Barkley had tests on the hamstring Monday. Nick Sirianni says more answers probably Wednesday.

RB8 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Sirianni's update Wednesday.
#FlyEaglesFly #DUUUVAL

Will Shipley ran 6 times for 23 Sunday after Barkley left. RB92 rest of season for me, a one-week body.

Claim him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB, only if you roster Barkley or need a Week 5 back.
#FlyEaglesFly

Lamar Jackson had his MRI. Jesse Minter gave no diagnosis but does not expect it to be crazy long-term, and would not commit to Sunday night vs ATL.

QB2 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#RavensFlock #DirtyBirds

Tyler Huntley is the backup if Jackson sits. In superflex, stash him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB.

In one-QB leagues, leave Huntley on the wire.
#RavensFlock

Ja'Marr Chase is still in the concussion protocol. Zac Taylor is taking him day to day.

WR1 rest of season for me. Monitor; the protocol and Wednesday's practice report.
#WhoDey

Tee Higgins caught 11 for 157 before the adductor strain on the final drive. Taylor calls him day to day too. WR16 rest of season for me; hold him.

Dohnte Meyers caught 7 for 82 once Chase left. Claim him, 8 to 15 percent of FAAB.
#WhoDey #DUUUVAL

Rashee Rice hurt the hamstring @LV. Andy Reid called it a tweak, and Monday's report called it relatively minor. Kansas City is off in Week 5.

WR17 rest of season for me. Hold him.
#ChiefsKingdom #RaiderNation

Tyquan Thornton dislocated his ankle and is out indefinitely. Drop him for any add.

Travis Kelce is TE9 rest of season for me and soaks up the short targets with Rice down; hold him.
#ChiefsKingdom

Caleb Williams will not practice this week with the Grade 2 hamstring, so Tyson Bagent starts again @GB after 268 yards vs NYJ.

Williams is QB11 rest of season for me; hold him.

Bagent is QB43; leave him on the wire.
#DaBears #GoPackGo

Kyle Monangai ran 30 times for 146 and two scores vs NYJ. Imaging on the thumb was clean and Ben Johnson expects him vs GB. RB36 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

D'Andre Swift sat after the fumble. RB13 rest of season; hold him.
#DaBears

Jayden Daniels will practice in full this week with the elbow, and Dan Quinn wants him starting vs NYG. Marcus Mariota is out multiple weeks with the MCL.

Daniels is QB18 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Drop Mariota.
#RaiseHail #NYGiants

DJ Moore aggravated the shoulder vs NE, but it is not considered long-term and he is day to day. WR24 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#BillsMafia #NEPats

Mack Hollins left with the calf in the BUF win, and Mike Vrabel had no update Monday. WR98 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.

Drake Maye threw for 269 and three scores. QB10 rest of season; hold.
#NEPats

Carnell Tate caught 9 for 145 @BAL on 12 targets, about 39 percent of Tennessee's targets.

WR34 rest of season for me, and the price only goes up. Trade for him; offer a WR3.
#TitanUp

Nico Collins caught 7 for 118 and two scores on 69 percent of the snaps in his first game back. WR8 rest of season for me.

Xavier Hutchinson gives back his Weeks 2 and 3 targets. Drop him.
#HTownMade

David Montgomery ran 10 times for 24 on 56 percent of the snaps vs DAL, and Woody Marks has scored two weeks running.

RB19 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a WR3 with a full-time route share.
#HTownMade #DallasCowboys

Michael Mayer has 10 targets working in two-tight-end sets next to Brock Bowers. TE36 rest of season for me.

In TE-premium leagues, add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#RaiderNation

Every injury call from Sunday and Monday is on the Pass page, with Tuesday's waiver run next.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Week 5's calls all week, and send this to the Barkley manager in your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/pass.html
